description: The file defines a PHP class Shipping within the OpenCart framework, responsible for handling shipping-related functionalities during checkout, including displaying shipping options, calculating quotes, validating inputs, and saving selected shipping methods.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Handles shipping options during checkout, including displaying available methods, validating user input, and setting shipping details in session.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping options view if shipping is enabled and cart has items with shipping.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Generates a shipping quote based on input data, validates country and zone, and returns available shipping methods or errors in JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the selected shipping method into the session after validation.
